back: READ: file must exist. WRITE: creates or empties the file. APPEND: adds to the end. RANDOM: any record can be read or written.
OPENFILE name FOR mode; READFILE name, Var; WRITEFILE name, Data; EOF(name); CLOSEFILE name.
Open for READ, WHILE NOT EOF(file) read and process each line, then CLOSEFILE.
Records stored in the order they were added.
Records stored in the order of a key field.
Fixed-length records; any record is reached directly with SEEK, GETRECORD and PUTRECORD.
Byte position = record number × record size (records numbered from 0); subtract 1 from the record number if numbering starts at 1.
An event that disrupts normal flow, such as a missing file, invalid conversion or division by zero.
try: code that may fail; except: the response to a named exception; finally: clean-up that always runs.
